milestones.title: Phase 0 — Foundations
milestones.description: Access, AI cost limits, ULearn contract, team working agreements.

milestones.title: Phase 1 — Session engine
milestones.description: Interview types, start/end session, transcript storage, quotas.

milestones.title: Phase 2 — AI interviewer & rubrics
milestones.description: Prompting, follow-ups, scoring rubrics, evaluation versions.

milestones.title: Phase 3 — Feedback & coaching
milestones.description: Scorecards, feedback, redo compare, drill suggestions.

milestones.title: Phase 4 — Voice & coding-in-interview
milestones.description: Voice mode, coding pane, system-design templates.

milestones.title: Phase 5 — Mentors, integrity, campus ops
milestones.description: Human review, quotas by college, integrity signals.

issues.title: INT-001: Project charter & definition of done
issues.body:
## Goal
Agree Team B scope and quality bar.

## Description
CRT is Team A. Interview owns conversational mocks, rubrics, feedback, voice, quotas.

## Expected output
- `CHARTER.md`
- DoD checklist
- Out-of-scope list (CRT syllabus, aptitude banks)

issues.title: INT-002: ULearn integration contract (Allowed Interview)
issues.body:
## Goal
Only users with `interview.access` can use Interview.

## Expected output
- `docs/ULEARN_CONTRACT.md`
- Gate on `/interview`
- Manual tests: allowed vs denied

issues.title: INT-003: AI provider spike (cost, latency, safety)
issues.body:
## Goal
Choose model/provider for text mocks and estimate cost per 30-min session.

## Description
Compare options; define secrets handling (never in frontend); outline prompt safety.

## Expected output
- `docs/AI_PROVIDER.md` with recommendation
- Rough cost table (tokens/minutes)
- Safety constraints list

issues.title: INT-004: Database schema v1 for Interview
issues.body:
## Goal
Tables for interview templates, sessions, turns, scores, quotas with RLS.

## Expected output
- ERD + migration + RLS
- Seed 2 templates (HR behavioral, SDE technical)
- Students only read own sessions

issues.title: INT-005: Wireframes — session, feedback, admin templates
issues.body:
## Goal
UX before build.

## Expected output
- Wireframes in `docs/wireframes/`
- Screen inventory signed off

issues.title: INT-010: Interview catalog (types & durations)
issues.body:
## Goal
Student picks interview type and duration.

## Expected output
- Catalog UI
- Templates: HR, Technical DSA, Domain (at least 3)
- Start button creates a session row

issues.title: INT-011: Text interview session loop
issues.body:
## Goal
Chat-style interview: AI asks → student answers → AI follow-up until time/questions done.

## Description
All AI calls via edge function (service role / secret). Persist each turn.

## Expected output
- Session UI with timer
- Edge function `interview-turn` (name flexible)
- Turns stored; session end state

issues.title: INT-012: Quotas (mocks per week)
issues.body:
## Goal
Fair use + cost control.

## Expected output
- Configurable default quota
- Block start when quota exceeded with clear message
- Admin can adjust quota per college later (stub OK)

issues.title: INT-013: Session history list
issues.body:
## Goal
Students see past mocks and open feedback.

## Expected output
- History page
- Status: in progress / completed / failed
- Link to scorecard

issues.title: INT-020: Persona & prompt CMS
issues.body:
## Goal
Admins edit interviewer persona and system prompts without code deploys.

## Expected output
- Admin UI or secured config table
- Version field on prompts
- Sessions store prompt version used

issues.title: INT-021: Rubric model & scoring job
issues.body:
## Goal
After session, score competencies (clarity, depth, STAR, correctness, communication).

## Expected output
- Rubric schema
- Post-session evaluation function
- Scores + short rationale per competency
- Evaluation version stored

issues.title: INT-022: Resume-aware questioning (MVP)
issues.body:
## Goal
Optional resume text/PDF → questions about projects.

## Expected output
- Upload/paste resume
- At least 2 resume-grounded questions in session
- Privacy note in UI

issues.title: INT-023: Safety filters & jailbreak resistance
issues.body:
## Goal
Refuse leaking answers, toxic content, off-platform misuse.

## Expected output
- Policy doc
- Automated test prompts + expected refusals
- Logging for safety events (no raw secrets)

issues.title: INT-030: Scorecard & transcript UI
issues.body:
## Goal
Readable feedback after each mock.

## Expected output
- Overall score + competency radar/bars
- Full transcript
- Strengths / improvements bullets

issues.title: INT-031: Suggested drills from weak competencies
issues.body:
## Goal
Turn feedback into next actions.

## Expected output
- 3–5 drill suggestions per completed session
- Optional deep-link stubs to CRT topics (contract only; CRT builds content)

issues.title: INT-032: Redo same interview seed (progress compare)
issues.body:
## Goal
Retake with same template/seed and compare scores.

## Expected output
- Redo action
- Side-by-side score compare view

issues.title: INT-033: Export feedback PDF
issues.body:
## Goal
Downloadable feedback for mentors/students.

## Expected output
- PDF download
- Includes scores + summary (not necessarily full raw chain-of-thought)

issues.title: INT-040: Voice interview MVP
issues.body:
## Goal
Speak answers (STT) and hear questions (TTS) or hybrid.

## Expected output
- Mic permission UX
- Voice session mode
- Cost/latency notes updated in AI_PROVIDER.md
- Fallback to text if mic fails

issues.title: INT-041: Coding pane inside technical interview
issues.body:
## Goal
During technical mocks, present a coding problem with editor + public tests.

## Expected output
- Coding step in technical template
- Store code + test results on session
- Rubric includes coding competency

issues.title: INT-042: System design structured template
issues.body:
## Goal
Guided system-design answers (requirements, API, data, scaling) without full whiteboard v1.

## Expected output
- Structured form + AI follow-ups
- Scored against design rubric

issues.title: INT-050: Mentor review & score override
issues.body:
## Goal
Mentors open completed sessions, comment, override AI scores with audit trail.

## Expected output
- Mentor queue/list
- Override form + reason required
- History of score changes

issues.title: INT-051: Integrity soft signals
issues.body:
## Goal
Tab blur counts / paste warnings (soft), separate from skill score.

## Expected output
- Integrity score field
- Student-facing soft warning
- Mentor can see integrity flags

issues.title: INT-052: College analytics & cost dashboard
issues.body:
## Goal
Sessions completed, average scores, estimated AI cost by college/batch.

## Expected output
- Admin analytics page
- Cost estimate from token/minute logs
- Export CSV

issues.title: INT-060: Rate limits, retries, failure UX
issues.body:
## Goal
Graceful handling when AI provider fails or is slow.

## Expected output
- Retry policy
- User-visible error states
- Session can be marked failed without losing transcript so far

issues.title: INT-061: Consent, retention, privacy checklist
issues.body:
## Goal
Especially for voice/recordings later.

## Expected output
- `docs/PRIVACY.md`
- Consent checkbox copy
- Retention defaults documented

issues.title: INT-062: QA test plan & handoff demo
issues.body:
## Goal
E2E demo for product owner.

## Expected output
- `docs/QA_PLAN.md`
- Demo script (HR mock + technical mock + feedback)
- Handoff notes for ULearn owners
